scenarios.name: Cluster Formation and Leader Election
scenarios.description: Validates that a multi-node cluster can form and elect a leader according to Raft consensus protocol

steps.description: Launch three MirDB nodes with cluster configuration specifying the same cluster membership
steps.context: All nodes should use identical cluster configuration; nodes can start in any order

steps.description: All nodes should discover each other and establish Raft communication within 30 seconds (REQ-2, US-1)
steps.context: Network connectivity required; nodes communicate over configured ports

steps.description: One node should be elected as leader; others should remain as followers (REQ-1)
steps.context: Raft election timeout configured; leader heartbeat should be active

steps.description: Client connections to any node should be accepted; writes to followers should be forwarded to leader
steps.context: Memcached protocol compatibility maintained; client can connect to any node

test_cases.input: Deploy 3-node cluster with valid configuration and query /health endpoint on each node
test_cases.expected: All nodes report healthy status; one node reports 'leader' role, others report 'follower'

test_cases.input: Execute memcached 'stats' command on follower node
test_cases.expected: Node responds with stats including 'role: follower' and leader address

test_cases.input: Monitor Raft metrics via /metrics endpoint
test_cases.expected: Prometheus metrics show raft_state, raft_term, raft_commit_index with valid values

scenarios.name: Automatic Failover and Leader Re-election
scenarios.description: Validates automatic leader failover when leader node fails, ensuring high availability (REQ-3)

steps.description: Start with fully operational cluster with elected leader and active followers
steps.context: Leader actively replicating logs to followers; all nodes synchronized

steps.description: Terminate leader node process or disconnect network (REQ-3, US-1)
steps.context: Simulates hardware failure, network partition, or graceful shutdown

steps.description: Followers should detect leader failure via missed heartbeats within election timeout
steps.context: Election timeout should trigger new election

steps.description: One follower should be elected as new leader within 10 seconds (REQ-3)
steps.context: New leader should have complete log; no committed entries should be lost

test_cases.input: Kill leader process in 3-node cluster and measure time to new leader election
test_cases.expected: New leader elected within 10 seconds; no committed writes lost; P99 latency impact < 50ms

test_cases.input: Disconnect network from leader (network partition scenario)
test_cases.expected: Followers elect new leader; old leader steps down when connectivity restored; split-brain avoided

test_cases.input: Perform writes during leader transition
test_cases.expected: Writes succeed after brief pause (< 10s); no duplicate or lost writes; linearizable consistency maintained

test_cases.input: Perform 1000 SET operations and verify operation metrics

test_cases.input: Query Raft-specific metrics in cluster mode

test_cases.input: Measure read throughput with and without read replicas under same load
test_cases.expected: With read replicas: 2x+ read throughput; P99 latency reduced by 30-50%; leader not overloaded with reads

test_cases.input: Monitor replication lag metrics on read replicas
test_cases.expected: Metrics show replication_lag_milliseconds with acceptable values; lag increases during high write load but catches up
